name: Picnic basket
summary: Woven wicker picnic basket with gingham cloth and a baguette sticking out; for picnic and park scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the basket rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the basket is hero size (~430 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, pop = scale in with overshoot
